rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 19, Step 5, question 1: "Did you, and your spouse if filing a joint return, have either an SSN or ITIN issued on or before the due date". The candidate tests the claimed dependents' TINs (Step 5, question 2) instead of the filers'. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/household.deepseek.json): 1,586 of 1,783 agree; 16 value differences, project False against candidate True, are filers without an SSN or ITIN (stage8.single.taxpayer_without_tin, stage13.odc_spouse_no_tin, stage13.ctc_spouse_no_id, classm.otjob.2); 174 candidate-refuses are dependent-line refusals the candidate reaches through dependent.claimed (multiple support, married, divorced rule, missing SSN: classm.asset.1, classm.carloan.3, classm.f8959.2); 7 project-unknown are fixtures that omit person.tin, which the candidate never reads (stage16.cleanup.refuse.rrta_medicare and others). Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 17, Before you begin: "only one spouse is required to have a valid SSN ... The other spouse must have either an SSN or ITIN, and it must have been issued on or before the due date of the return". The candidate requires person.tin (or an applied-for ITIN, which the text excludes because it must have been issued) of every person, including one whose SSN valid for employment already meets the requirement. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/household.deepseek.json): 1,759 of 1,783 agree; 7 candidate-unknown records answer work_ssn true and leave person.tin unasked (stage16.cleanup.refuse.rrta_medicare, stage16.cleanup.f5695_no_audit), an answer the text does not need; the 17 value differences (classm.otjob.2, classm.sc.3, classm.ssb.2, classm.tcw.8/10/11 recorded) answer work_ssn true with tin false, contradictory answers a truthful interview does not produce. Project stands.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 14, Head of Household: "Check the 'Head of household' box only if you are unmarried (or considered unmarried) and either Test 1 or Test 2 applies", where Test 1 is a home kept up for your parent and only Test 2 is "a home in which you lived". The candidate never reads f1040.status, so it reports a failure on every return that is not head of household, and it requires household.home_cost (your own home) for Test 1 as well. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/household.deepseek.json): 425 of 1,783 agree; 1,216 value differences, project False against candidate True, are mostly returns not filed as head of household (classm.f2441.2.deepseek: status mfj, home_cost false); 46 candidate-unknown records lack household.unmarried on non-HOH returns (classm.f8889.3.deepseek, stage16.cleanup.refuse.f1040_line16); 93 candidate-refuses are dependent refusals reached on non-HOH returns (classm.asset.1, classm.sc.1); the 3 project-refuses are cited project gates (audit.dependent.hoh_test1_no_tin: claimed_no_tin; generated 357: married dependent; audit.household.hoh_community_property: amb.2025.hoh_community_property). The project's own death-year defect in the Test 1/Test 2 inputs is ruled as a finding in the Claude log.

Ruling: model error; f1040 p. 1: "If joint return, spouse's first name and middle initial". The line is the check that the person entries match the filing status (one entry for you, a spouse entry exactly on a joint return); the candidate instead flags dependents answering divorced_rule, married, multiple_support or other_claimant, conditions the project screens on the dependent lines themselves. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/household.deepseek.json): 1,634 of 1,783 agree; 126 value differences, project False against candidate True, are returns with a correct roster and a dependent so answered (classm.f8889.2.deepseek, classm.asset.1, classm.carloan.3, classm.g28.2, classm.gift.1); 22 candidate-unknown records have no dependent roster (ss.multi, ss.base.below and others); the 1 project-refuses is the under-16 entry check, amb.2025.filer_under_16. Project stands.
